final_message:
Program `f1` is done. Both PRs merged through the gates. No required human action remains.

Defaults taken: H1 approved, H2 skipped under `send`, and the default Node TAP command configured. Council used three available GPT models because the Claude defaults were unavailable.

Final base SHA: `e29e0fb3a9655ada23a06e3ed1e3c4137a914108`.

- All 24 acceptance lanes passed, run by a fresh `gpt-6-astra` verifier.

Council scored the change **9/10 on all three models**. No confirmed blockers remained. [Proposed issue #85](https://github.com/oddballmeasure/cstack-testbed/issues/85) records an ambiguity about whitespace-only ledger lines.

Autonomy was `send` from the run record and launch environment. Parallelism was 1. The run recorded 28 decisions, zero restarts, and zero usage-limit waits. Sequence Verifiable Units kept the suite merge before implementation; Prove It Works required final-SHA evidence.

Artifacts remain in [the run store](/home/monty/cstack/tests/fixture
